rows.text: The President of the Assembly reads the decree of the President of the Republic convening Parliament in extraordinary session from Monday 27 August 1990, 'Fait à Paris, le 22 août 1990', signed FRANÇOIS MITTERRAND with 'Par le Président de la République :' and 'Le Premier ministre, MICHEL ROCARD'; he states that it appeared in the Journal officiel of 23 August 1990.

locator.item: 1 - Ouverture de la deuxième session extraordinaire de 1989-1990

rows.text: At the sitting of 27 August 1990 the President of the Assembly reads a letter from the President of the Republic dated 'Paris, le 27 août 1990', sent under Article 18 of the Constitution and signed FRANÇOIS MITTERRAND, and the message it transmits; the Assembly takes note ('donne acte') of the message of the President of the Republic.

locator.item: 2 - Message de M. le Président de la République

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-23 only (Président de la République, 1 January 1990 to the 7 September 2026 cutoff). Election rounds, the Constitutional Council's proclamation, its publication, the investiture ceremony, a stated start of term, an outer limit and any stated end stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. Prime ministers, ministers, party offices and the President of the Senate's interim office are excluded.
